Absolutely: take a bird, a fish, a beast, or a viper;
Each one has its own measure and acts according to it;
If nature has given it a suitable virtue,
They go toward the goal that it is heading toward.

Their lord is the human, but [he is] stupider, but [he is] worse than his servants.
This isn't news with lords. He uses their apt service,
But ungratefully drives them, free, into fetters.
